author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
The chamomile harvest is a beautiful reminder that summer’s gifts can be enjoyed all year long 🌼🍃 In this video, we gather fragrant chamomile flowers by hand and preserve them the traditional village way, creating a natural herbal tea for the colder months ahead.

The blossoms are carefully harvested and gently dried to preserve their delicate aroma, golden color, and soothing qualities. Every step reflects the simple rhythm of countryside life and the timeless tradition of preparing nature’s harvest for winter.

This is authentic village preserving at its finest — fresh herbs, gentle drying, and generations of traditional knowledge. A simple and natural way to capture the warmth of summer and enjoy a comforting cup of chamomile tea throughout the winter. 🌿☕🌼
title: Chamomile Harvest – Preserving Summer for Winter 🌼🍃
